Text A. We sell new and used books. The used books are cheap, and there is a quiet place to sit and read. We open at nine and close at five. On Saturdays a writer reads a story to children at ten. You do not need a ticket.

Text B. Our outdoor market opens at eight every Sunday. You can buy fresh fruit and vegetables from local gardens. Please bring a shopping bag. We close at one, so come in the morning. We do not sell clothes.

Text C. Our shop has three departments: clothes, toys and sports. You can try on clothes before you buy. Shop assistants help you find the right size. The store is open until seven, and a café upstairs serves snacks while you rest.
